## Premise corrected · 2026-11-17T13:19Z

This is the seat's ruling on o3-C's live reading at origin/main `c513d62` (os-dev-report 6949054984). Every symptom reproduces. Items 1, 4 and 5 fit the claim. Items 2, 3, 6 and 7 live in files the card's Reader line did not name, and item 2 is wider than the card measured.

- **Item 2 (internal names and 「CEL 表达式」 in node properties):** the surface widens to `inspectors/ObjectPicker.tsx` (the monospace object line), `inspectors/FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` and `FlowReferenceField.tsx` (「目标为…记录」 / 「…的字段」), and `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. That covers the 「CEL 表达式…recordId」 help and the dozen or so other node help rows that say CEL 表达式. All of them are wording in the card's own scope.
- **Item 3 (delete into the title-bar 「···」 menu):** the Studio title bar is the automation aside's `StudioInspector` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (around :9518-9545). Take route A: an actions slot plus a portal target on `InspectorShellHost` (`inspectors/_shared.tsx`). `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, so this is no published widening. Deleting a node has no confirmation today, from either the footer or the canvas key, and **the card keeps that**. No confirmation is added here; that would be new behaviour the card did not ask for.
- **Item 6 (view column rows show the internal name):** `metadata-admin/previews/ViewColumnPanes.tsx` `FieldListRow` is shared with Setup's `ViewColumnInspector` and `ViewVariantInspector`. The seat takes **B**: hide the visible name in Studio only, through a prop, and keep the hover title. The card is about Studio, and Setup is an administrator's surface where the internal name is still useful, so changing it there would reach past the card. If the filer wants it everywhere, that is a separate card.
- **Item 7 (navigation item types in Chinese):** `metadata-admin/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx` (`navKind` returns the raw type). Reuse `navKindName` from `studio-design/InterfacesNavRail.tsx:83` instead of writing a second table.

## Claim amendment

This amends claim 6948357424.

- **Surface adds:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectPicker.tsx`, `…/inspectors/FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`, `…/inspectors/FlowReferenceField.tsx`, `…/inspectors/_shared.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the automation aside's title bar only), `…/metadata-admin/previews/ViewColumnPanes.tsx` (an opt-in prop; Setup stays byte-identical), `…/metadata-admin/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx`, and their tests. New strings go to the lazy `studio` namespace.
- **Clause-②: no** (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private). No seat L2 is owed unless the final file list says otherwise.
- **Out of scope**, sent to the filer as an epic note: the zh 「更新记录」 node shows the English "Update every matching record", because the engine configSchema field `multi` (`service-automation` `crud-nodes.ts:934`) has no zh row in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. If o3-C's `i18n.ts` edit touches that table anyway, adding the row is in scope here.
